title: 호텔+미우 통합게시판 주문입력 — 이미지/텍스트 합산 후 주문수량만 가산

actions.name: PARSE_IMAGE_OR_TEXT
actions.sideEffect: JSON {text} uses parseHotelMiuText only (no Vision, no image matchName). multipart file uses Vision OCR. Clipboard with Excel TSV+bitmap prefers text. Unit 대 is 송이 (steam), not 박스. read Product + order-mappings.json + WebHotelMiuProductMap overlay, then applyBoardOverlay so a once-picked name stays matched. No persistImportMatchMappings. No Order/Shipment write.

actions.name: SAVE_BOARD_PRODUCT_MAP
actions.sideEffect: INSERT WebHotelMiuProductMap overlay only. Also upserted when DRAFT/REGISTERED batch lines with ProdKey are saved. Does not write data/order-mappings.json.

actions.name: FAVORITE_CUSTOMER_WEEK
actions.sideEffect: Default chips 라움/신라/쵸이문/미우 resolved from Customer by name. Extra vendors stored in UserFavorite page=hotel-miu-board. Week chips are current OrderWeek through 36-02 of the selected year. Selected OrderYear+OrderWeek+CustKey go to later writes. Ledger preserve.

actions.name: READ_BOX_FACTORS
actions.sideEffect: GET prodKeys reads Product BunchOf1Box/SteamOf1Box/SteamOf1Bunch only. No Order/Shipment write.

actions.name: SAVE_DRAFT_BATCH
actions.sideEffect: INSERT WebHotelMiuIntakeBatch Status=DRAFT + lines for selected OrderYear+OrderWeek+CustKey. No Order/Shipment write. Displayed as 1합산/2합산.

actions.name: REGISTER_ORDER_ADD
actions.sideEffect: POST /api/orders source=hotel-miu-board isDelta add of merged DRAFT batches for selected OrderYear+OrderWeek+CustKey+ProdKey after a UI table confirm. Hidden OrderMaster/OrderDetail (isDeleted=1, qty 0) for the same year+week+cust+prod are revived instead of inserting a second row. Items that do not fill a box can be rounded up/down to whole boxes on that confirm table only; 합산 원문은 유지. markRegistered also INSERTs WebHotelMiuRegisterSnap (before/after qty) for the week popup. ShipmentMaster is not ensured (not raum-pnl). Cross-year same OrderWeek is excluded.

actions.name: READ_REGISTER_HISTORY
actions.sideEffect: After a vendor is selected, clicking a week chip GETs WebHotelMiuRegisterSnap + REGISTERED 합산 + ViewOrder 전산 현재 for that OrderYear+OrderWeek+CustKey and opens a popup of 반올림 전 vs 반올림 후 vs 전산 현재. No Order/Shipment write. Cross-year same OrderWeek is excluded.

actions.name: REVISE_BATCH_INCREASE
actions.sideEffect: batchQtyDelta positive qty is sent to createOrder as signed add. WebHotelMiuIntakeLine replaced for that BatchKey scoped by OrderYear+OrderWeek+CustKey. Shipment preserve.

actions.name: REVISE_BATCH_DECREASE
actions.sideEffect: batchQtyDelta negative qty is sent to createOrder as signed subtract, including when a 합산 line is deleted or the whole 합산 is deleted. If cancel exceeds remaining OrderDetail.OutQuantity (e.g. leftover 0.33 box after a previous overlapping delete), hotel-miu-board clamps to 0 and hides the row instead of throwing. Missing OrderDetail on that year+week+cust+prod is skipped. Empty updateBatch still soft-deletes the web batch (isDeleted=1) scoped by OrderYear+OrderWeek+CustKey. Does not write Shipment*/Estimate/WebProfitReport. Card 삭제/× honor busy so this cannot overlap REGISTER_ORDER_ADD stock calc.

actions.name: BLOCK_OVERLAPPING_WRITE
actions.sideEffect: writeLock + disabled={!!busy} block 합산 삭제/×/주문등록/다시 더하기 while a prior POST /api/orders is in flight. Prevents overlapping negative delta from wiping the just-added OrderDetail. No extra Order/Shipment write.

actions.name: REAPPLY_REGISTER_SNAP
actions.sideEffect: Week popup 등록내역을 전산에 다시 더하기 posts snap afterQty as signed add for selected OrderYear+OrderWeek+CustKey+ProdKey. Revives hidden OrderDetail instead of a second row. Does not write Shipment*/Estimate/WebProfitReport. Cross-year same OrderWeek is excluded.

crossYearFixture.description: 2025와 2026의 동일 차수(예: 33-01)라도 화면 연도+차수+CustKey만 조회·가산한다. 전년도 Master를 재사용하지 않는다.
